name: live_collar
description: A Dead Money collar death is not revivable. The guest dies of its collar: a down under NVDLC01BombCollarQuest, whose policy row says down until_checkpoint (coop down: campaign::downed::script_down, the path a collar script's KillActor on the player takes through downed::health_out). A teammate tries to revive it at 6 s (campaign revive) and at 8 s (live hold-to-revive). Both are refused (downed::revive refuses a held down), and the live window does not respawn it (the down is reported to the live rules as not revivable). The guest stays down until the party reaches a checkpoint cell.
